HomePage.title: SiriusMenu: Digital menu with QR
HomePage.description: QR menu for cafes and restaurants. Enter products, choose a theme, put the QR code on the table. Instant price update, no printing costs.
HomePage.heroSubtitle: Fast, easy and cost-free digital menu experience.

hero.title: Put a QR on the table, the menu opens on the phone.
hero.subtitle: Enter your products, pick a theme, put the QR code on the table. The customer scans it and the menu opens instantly on their phone. When a price changes, update it in one place; printing costs and outdated menus become a thing of the past.

showcase.title: Photo-rich, live, one QR code on the phone.
showcase.subtitle: SiriusMenu isn't a PDF, it's a living menu. Product photos, categories, prices and tags open up crisp and clean on the phone. Change one item and everyone sees the new version instantly.

features.title: No print shop, no print hassle

items.d: Text the registered number "Latte is now 120" and the menu changes instantly. No need to log into the panel.
Upload a food photo you took on your phone; AI fixes the lighting, color and background to make it menu-ready.
Remove a sold-out item in seconds, write the new price. Customers always see the current menu.
Type the product name and AI suggests an appetizing description. No more empty description boxes.
Cafe, classic, modern, night, garden and sea. Pick the look that fits your place in one click.
No trip to the print shop every time the menu changes. Print the QR once, update the content from the screen forever.
Add allergen badges, calories, weight and small/large portion prices to each item. Guests see it without having to ask.
Upload a photo or file of your printed menu and the items appear in a list. Nothing is added to your menu until you approve it.
If a printed QR falls into the wrong hands, renew it from the panel in one click; old printed QR codes stop working.

items.q: Does the customer need to download an app?
items.a: No. Scanning the QR with the phone camera is enough; the menu opens directly in the browser. No app is installed, no account is required.

items.q: Do I need to reprint the QR when the price changes?
items.a: No. The QR always points to the same link; once you update the content, the customer sees the current menu automatically the next time they scan it.
The customer's phone needs internet to open the menu; mobile data is more than enough. For venues with weak signal, we recommend leaving a short Wi-Fi note on the table.

items.q: How many products can I add?
items.a: On the trial plan you can set up and preview your menu and download your QR. Paid plans support large menus (200+ items).

items.q: Can I add my own logo and colors?
items.a: On paid plans you can add your logo and pick the look that fits your venue best from six ready-made themes.

items.q: What is the difference between the plans?
items.a: Basic covers QR menu publishing, themes, logo, instant updates and menu import from photos. Full adds menu updates via WhatsApp and a monthly AI photo quota. Professional includes everything in Full plus a higher AI photo quota. See the side-by-side table in the pricing section.

items.q: Why is there a setup fee, and is it paid every month?
items.a: The setup fee is charged once with the first subscription and does not repeat. In later periods you only pay the plan price.

items.q: How much do I save by paying yearly?
items.a: With yearly billing you pay for 10 months instead of 12, so 2 months are free. Each plan's saving is shown on its price card.

items.q: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
items.a: Yes. You can cancel any time from the panel via "Manage subscription". No refund is given for a subscription period already used; after cancelling, your menu stays published and only editing from the panel is locked. Details are on the Refund and Cancellation Policy page.
To change plans, use the "Manage subscription" link in the panel or write to us on WhatsApp or by email.

items.q: Is there an extra charge for the QR code?
items.a: No. Downloading the QR code and printing it as often as you like is free. Your QR address is fixed; price and product updates do not change it.

items.q: How do I show allergen and calorie information?
items.a: In the panel, open the "Details" section of each product to mark allergens and add calories, weight and portion prices such as small/large. The business is responsible for the accuracy of this information.

items.q: How does updating via WhatsApp work?
items.a: On the Full and Professional plans, you send a message like "Make latte 120" from your authorised number and the menu updates instantly. Messages from unregistered numbers are rejected, and you can write "geri" (Turkish for "undo") to revert the last change.

items.q: Can you build the menu for me?
items.a: Yes. With the turnkey setup service we prepare your product list, descriptions and photos. The price depends on the number of products and what you need; details are in the panel and the pricing section.
Yes. Your menu content and images belong to you. You can delete your account from the panel; how long data is kept and when it is deleted is described in the Privacy Policy and the KVKK Notice.

studio.title: Work with your own photos
studio.desc: Upload your own product photos instead of a template image; if you like, AI can recreate the lighting, background and sharpness in the highest detail. You can also add an extra instruction (e.g. "on a wooden table"): the product itself and its presentation are always kept fixed, only the detail you asked for is added. This is a more powerful version of the quick Enhance button on the product row in the panel and uses the same photo quota.
